users: researchers and facilities teams designing door-open infiltration experiments
supported_tasks: plan required measurements for site evaluation
not_intended_for: a safety, food-quality, or operational alarm setpoint; refrigeration-load sizing; or guaranteed energy-savings claim

required_inputs: declared geometry, indoor conditions, and exchange assumptions

limitations: The effective exchange multiplier is an explicit unvalidated representation of obstructions and curtains.
The model omits traffic-induced flow, HVAC pressurization, wind, frost, product thermal mass, refrigeration-control response, and strip-curtain mechanics.
